text:
You know there is something
wrong with the girl but the thought
of leaving her here chained to the
wall of a madman’s lair is too
abhorrent to you . As soon as you
break her chain, she stares up at
you and mutters a spell. All she
needed was to have her hands
free to wave at you. Save vs. L4
magic, at +1 if you have the Will
Skill and at +2 if you have it at
Expert level. If you succeed, you
lose 1 Sanity but you manage to
escape from the room, with the
girl’s cackling laughter ringing in
your ears. If you fail, lose d6 Sanity
as the young witch tries to take
control of your mind. If after this
you are still sane, you must fight
her to make it out of here alive.
Eliza, L3 witch, 3 Life, attacks by
spell (Save vs. L3 Magic or lose 1
Sanity). You may not escape from
this fight.
If you kill Eliza, you find a
parchment with a curse spell
crumpled in her pockets. You may
use this to learn the Curse ritual
(see Arcane Skills).

zh-CN.title: 8 - 伊莱莎的诅咒
text:
你知道这个女孩不对劲，但把她留在疯子巢穴的墙边、继续锁在那里，实在令你无法接受。你一解开锁链，她便抬头盯着你，开始低声念咒。她只需要腾出双手向你挥动。进行一次L4魔法防御检定；拥有意志技能时+1，达到专家级时+2。成功则失去1点理智，但设法逃出房间，耳边仍回荡着女孩的咯咯笑声。失败则在年轻女巫试图控制你心智时失去1D6点理智。若此后你仍未陷入疯狂，就必须打败她才能活着离开。
伊莱莎：L3女巫，3点生命，以法术攻击（进行L3魔法防御检定，失败则失去1点理智）。这场战斗中不能逃跑。
若杀死伊莱莎，你会在她口袋里找到一张皱巴巴的诅咒法术羊皮纸。你可以用它学习“诅咒”仪式（见奥术技能）。
